snippet.description:
Master Second Order Partial Derivatives & Mixed Derivatives in Calculus. Complete step-by-step solved examples for B.Sc Mathematics and Engineering exams.

Hello Learners! Welcome back to Fractal Frontier Maths.

Is video lecture mein hum detail mein cover kar rahe hain Partial Differentiation ka important topic: Second Order Partial Derivatives & Mixed Derivatives ($\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x \partial y}$).

Agar aap B.Sc Mathematics, B.Tech/Engineering Maths, GATE, ya competitive exams ki preparation kar rahe hain, toh yeh lecture aapke calculus concepts ko bilkul clear aur strong bana dega.

📌 What you will learn in this lecture:

Concept of Second Order & Higher Order Partial Derivatives
Step-by-step method to solve Mixed Partial Derivatives
Important textbook & university exam problems solved in detail
Tips to avoid common mistakes while differentiating step-by-step

Timestamps
00:00 - Introduction & Overview of Second Order Partial Derivatives
01:05 - Example 1: Mixed Partial Derivative
11:53 - Example 2
18:02 - Example 3
27:26 - Example 4
37:34 - Example 5
50:38 - Example 6: Polar/Composite Function
58:04 - Summary & Preview of Euler's Theorem for Next Lecture

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
What is Partial Differentiation? → https://youtu.be/1i67M96-iP8

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

💬 Koi bhi doubt ya question ho toh niche comment section mein zaroor batayein! Like, Share aur Subscribe karna na bhulein.
